en: Hm... That's strange...

<CLT=cltMIND>There are fewer plants around here.
Some places are being renovated as well...

They did say it was under construction.
I suppose construction is still ongoing...

<CLT=cltMIND>But where exactly is this
academy built, anyway?

<CLT=cltMIND>No one has come to save us...
It must be someplace remote.

<CLT=cltMIND>But where could you build a complex
this large in secret?

Oh, Shuichi! Have you solved the 
mystery of the junk yet?

That weird projection there... I've got a 
feeling you can use that one thing with it.
Well, I've got no idea how, though!

But my hunches are usually right!
Let's give it a try!

That weird projection there... I've got a 
feeling you can use that one thing with it.
Well, I've got no idea how, though!

But my hunches are usually right!
Let's give it a try!

Wh-Whoa! It opened so suddenly...
it freaked me out...

But my hunch was right on the money!
So that junk was for opening this.
Alright! Let's go inside!

That item we received earlier... I think we
can use it on this stone monument.
Can you try?
It looks like there's a pool inside.

We should take a closer look. It would be
best to know the specifics.

I can't believe what happened in the dining
hall earlier... Males are so insensitive!

I wouldn't ever dare to ask why you
decided to remove your hat!

That's something that should be kept private
between you and Kaede!
Thank you, Tenko...
I...also feel that I must carry on Kaede's wish.

No matter what, we'll get out of here!
I won't give up!

Shuichi, don't ever conduct yourself in such
a shameful manner ever again!
Ah, yeah...I won't.
I...also feel that I must carry on Kaede's wish.

No matter what, we'll get out of here!
And I won't give up!

Well then, Shuichi! Lead the way, you lousy
degenerate!

Shout if you find a trap! But I won't help you!
Because you're a degenerate male!

<CLT=cltMIND>This looks like the gates of a castle.
What could be on the other side...?
<CLT=cltMIND>The vine suddenly withered...

The ivy withered in seconds.
What remarkable technology...

Ah! We can get in! We can go in from
there, right!?

...You intend to go inside? That course
of action seems dangerous.

No, it's not dangerous. There's just a pool
in there.
...Pool?

Yeah, this is a pool.
Schools and pools are inseparable.

24-hour convenience stores and blonde
hooligans are also inseparable.
...WONDERFUL-EXPLANATION.
Huh? Th-Thank you.

Hmph... I dunno why bein' praised by the guy
who killed our bro makes you so happy...

What should we do? There may be a pool,
but we're not going in for a swim, are we?

But...if it is not dangerous, then maybe we
should take a look.
It is never bad to have too much information.
Yes, I suppose you're right...

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item, the vine suddenly
withered... How does that work?

<CLT=cltMIND>That door I can see over there must
lead somewhere into the school...
<CLT=cltMIND>Where could it lead?
<CLT=cltMIND>So this is the key to the gate...
Casino Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick (Closed)
